title: agent-team-evals run record
description: One line of results/*.jsonl = one run of one config on one task (one repetition).

schema_version.description: Bump when a field changes meaning.

sweep_id.description: UTC timestamp id shared by every run in one `ate run` call.

model.description: Model alias passed to --model, identical across configs.

dry_run.description: True = no API calls were made; cost is zero.

status.description: passed/failed come from hidden tests. budget_exceeded/timeout/agent_error mean the pipeline stopped early (still graded; a fail if tests fail). rate_limited/auth_error/harness_error say nothing about the config: they are excluded from statistics and re-run by `ate run --resume`.

passed.description: Every hidden test passed. The headline metric.

tests.description: Hidden-test counts; passed/total is the partial-credit score.

cost_usd.description: Sum of total_cost_usd over all stages: Claude Code's client-side estimate at API prices. On a subscription nothing is billed per token; read it as API-equivalent cost.

agent_wall_s.description: Wall-clock seconds spent in agent stages (excludes setup and grading).

num_turns.description: Summed agentic turns over all stages.

stages.description: Per-stage detail: name, agent, cost_usd, tokens, num_turns, duration_s, subtype, is_error, exit_code, structured, command.

review_verdict.description: APPROVE / CHANGES_NEEDED / null when the config has no reviewer or it failed to answer.

fix_round.description: Whether the one allowed fix stage ran.

diff.description: Size of the agents' change vs the seed commit.

touched_tests.description: Agents changed files under tests/ (expected: they add tests).

read_only_violations.description: Read-only stages that changed files (the harness reverted them).

leak_suspected.description: Suspicious strings (hidden-test or solution paths) found in transcripts.

harness_sha.description: git HEAD of this repo when the run started.

attempt.description: 1 unless --resume re-ran this (task, config, rep) after a retryable status.

isolation_flags.description: Signs the personal Claude setup leaked in (CLAUDE.md canary, plugins or MCP servers loaded).
